description: Populated crosswalk rows. Schema and namespace registry are defined in interop-crosswalk.json. Every emitted tag was checked against the live tag API for existence and deprecation. Lossy mappings state what they discard.

verification.tag_existence_and_deprecation: All emitted tags, primary and support, were checked against the live tag API. None is absent from the permitted vocabulary and none is deprecated.
verification.wiki_sense_checks_documented: 46 of 104 rows carry a recorded wiki check with a verbatim quote. The remainder were mapped without a documented wiki read. This crosswalk should not be described as wiki-verified end to end.
verification.method: Mappings were produced in batches, adversarially verified by an independent reviewer per batch, then swept for completeness. Rows flagged by the sweep were re-settled against tag wiki text and independently adjudicated.

conventions.support_tags: Support tags reconstruct structure that the primary tag discards. They are not a restatement of the act and are not quality or style tokens.
conventions.surface: on_bed is emitted wherever the position support_surface is a flat bed regardless of the figure posture, so the surface axis is carried uniformly. Read it as a scene-surface assertion rather than a strict posture claim.
conventions.camera_tags: Image-composition tags are excluded from support sets except where the position is genuinely a camera-relative one. from_behind appears once, on the single solo row where the rear three-quarter viewpoint is the intended sense.
conventions.parent_child: A tag may be exact for a parent position and broader for its catalog children. That is SKOS hierarchy, not a collision.

undocumented_tags.note: These tags are live and not deprecated, but their wiki page body is empty. No claim about their extension beyond the plain sense of the name is sourceable, and rows using them are held below exact.
